pipelines.sql: SELECT window_start, window_end, asn, count(*) AS n FROM indicators GROUP BY tumble(INTERVAL '5 minutes'), asn HAVING count(*) > 50
SELECT window_start, window_end, ip, count(*) AS n FROM indicators GROUP BY tumble(INTERVAL '1 hour'), ip

SELECT window_start, window_end, ip, count(DISTINCT asn) AS d, sum(asn) AS s, avg(asn) AS av, min(asn) AS lo, max(asn) AS hi FROM indicators GROUP BY hop(INTERVAL '5 minutes', INTERVAL '1 minute'), ip
